title: 第7章 初战第8章 神秘的剑匣
slug: 剑帝第6901章阴天子的悔意
lines: 此刻孙勇身体都有些发抖，这不是什么害怕担忧，而是激动，就像是沙漠中即将要渴死的旅人突然碰到了绿洲一样，心中的狂喜是难以遏制的。
难以想象，若不能完成孙龙下达的任务的话，未来究竟如何？
要知道，虽然孙勇也姓孙，但与孙龙完全不同，孙龙是嫡传血脉，至于他，只不过是一个下人罢了，根本就没有任何孙家的血统，甚至这个姓都是被主家的恩赐。
就论身份地位的而言，即便是孙冰都比他高贵上无数倍，毕竟不管怎么样，孙冰好歹也是义子。
激动过后，孙勇的脸上露出了一丝狰狞，同时心中狂笑：“当真是天无绝人之路啊，孙冰我可真得好好谢谢你啊，你也是时运不济，天堂有路你不走，地狱无门你自来投。
我们两个人只有一个人能活下来，功法殿前你那般羞辱我，再加上我未来的前途还有小命，就只能那你来顶缸了，你就安心的去吧。”
说到这里，孙勇一点也没有反思自己以前的行为是多么的可恶，总是把错误归咎到别人身上。
至于孙冰在走进落云镇中就发现了孙勇，尤其是对方那仿佛想把他吃了的眼神，心中暗暗一笑：“没有想到把你激出来了，正好孙杨估计已经等得有点不耐烦了，你过来刚好陪他下地狱。”
只不过现在毕竟还是在落云镇中，来来往往有着无数的居民，孙勇暗道：若是强抢的话，目击证人实在是太多了，更何况还不能让孙冰知晓秘籍在谁那里，只能偷过来了。
其实不管用什么方法，孙勇都不介意，毕竟孙冰已经出现了，最起码有一个目标，同时心中也是信心十足，就算孙冰能够修炼又如何？他已经到了淬体境四层，根本就不是刚刚踏入修炼的孙冰所能抵挡的。
孙冰现在也在纠结，虽然自己现在很想要击杀对方，但却不能暴露出来，因为离开了孙家，他实在是没有什么办法能够获得武功秘籍，所以只能期待能够找到一个机会。
两个人互相对视一眼，然后擦肩而过，可以说是两人都各有心思，但目标却惊人的相同，那就是希望对方死。
不知不觉，夜已经深了。
今晚的夜色格外的凄凉，就连往日那皎洁的月光也被乌云遮挡，瞬间让整个落云镇漆黑无比，只有豪门大院中才有亮光传出。
“月黑风高杀人夜。”一个偏僻的房间中，孙勇换了一身漆黑的衣裳，就准备前去偷功法秘籍。
孙冰的住所相当偏僻，这也是他自己的选择，反正他在家族中的存在感相当低，远离人群正好，甚至此处连巡逻的侍卫都懒得前来，只要没有发生天大的事情，这里根本就不会引人注目。
所以孙勇的行动相当胆大，不多时就来到了破旧的门前，小心翼翼的朝里面窥探，可还没有等他查看清楚，突然间耳边传来了一阵声音：“不进来坐坐么？”
这让孙勇整个人如同惊弓之鸟，肌肉瞬间紧绷，向后一跃，房门打开，就看见孙冰正在房中盘腿而坐，一柄木剑横放在腿上，似乎已经等待良久了。
“被发现了”这是孙勇脑海中唯一的念头，只不过他不但没有逃跑，反而面露狠色，因为现在退去想要再回来偷那就更难了，还不如改成强抢，直接抽出了自己的随身宝剑。
望着那一道闪过过来的寒光，孙冰并没有任何担忧，反而充满了兴奋，上一次击杀孙杨，其中起到主要作用的还是他这辈子出的第一剑，蕴含的精气神太多了，如同拔刀斩一样，威力强大，对方根本就没有任何抵抗，直接一招瞬秒，最后却得不到任何战斗经验。
今天正好有一个对手能够让他磨砺自身，当下手持墨色木剑，与面前的孙勇进行战斗。
木剑与铁剑接触，只发出了一声闷响，竟然丝毫没有被斩断的迹象，这让孙勇的双目中闪烁着浓浓的惊讶，因为在他的心中，孙冰不过是刚刚能够修炼罢了，至于他则已经淬体四层了。
虽然说这一剑被挡住了，但孙勇也没有丝毫担心，因为这就是他的随手一击罢了，能接下也没有什么大不了的，不过态度就有些认真了：“没有想到你竟然能接下我的随手一剑，接下来就要小心了。”
说罢，直接的使用基础剑法，再次挥剑上前，只不过孙冰望着那有些粗陋不堪的剑法，嘴边嘲讽一笑，每一剑都能够巧妙的击中对方的破绽，哪怕他的力量再怎么强大，也根本无济于事。
一时间，两个人就已经交锋数个回合，小院中只能听到剑舞声。
随着时间的推移，孙勇的心中已经渐渐生出了一种恐惧，他实在没有想到，才短短数日不见孙冰，对方竟然已经这么强了，同时心中充满了嫉妒与狠辣。
若说原先孙勇只不过是想把那秘籍偷过来陷害他的话，现在就不想多此一举了，反而倾向于在今晚就把孙冰击杀，哪怕这其中有暴露的危险，他也不管不顾了。
content_en:
At this moment, Sun Yong's body was trembling a little. This was not because of fear or worry, but because of excitement, just like a traveler who was about to die of thirst in the desert and suddenly encountered an oasis. The ecstasy in his heart was uncontrollable.
It’s hard to imagine what the future will be like if we can’t complete the tasks assigned by Sun Long?
You must know that although Sun Yong also has the surname Sun, he is completely different from Sun Long. Sun Long is the direct descendant of the bloodline. As for him, he is just a servant. He has no bloodline from the Sun family at all. Even this surname is a gift from the master's family.
In terms of status, even Sun Bing was countless times more noble than him. After all, Sun Bing was still an adopted son no matter what.
After the excitement, Sun Yong's face showed a trace of ferocity, and he laughed wildly in his heart: "There is no end to the road. Sun Bing, I really need to thank you. You are also unlucky. There is a road to heaven but you don't take it, and there is no door to hell but you take it yourself."
Only one of us can survive. You humiliated me like that in front of the Kung Fu Hall. In addition, I still have a small chance of success in the future, so I can only support you. You can go with peace of mind. "
At this point, Sun Yong did not reflect at all on how abominable his previous behavior was, and always blamed others for his mistakes.
As for Sun Bing, he spotted Sun Yong when he walked into Luoyun Town, especially the look in his eyes that seemed to want to eat him. He secretly smiled in his heart: "I didn't expect to provoke you. It just so happens that Sun Yang is probably a little impatient with waiting. You come here just in time to accompany him to hell."
But now we are still in Luoyun Town, with countless residents coming and going. Sun Yong secretly thought: If it is a robbery, there will be too many witnesses, not to mention that Sun Bing cannot know who has the secret book, so he can only steal it.
In fact, no matter what method he uses, Sun Yong doesn't mind. After all, Sun Bing has already appeared. At least he has a goal and is full of confidence in his heart. So what if Sun Bing can practice? He has reached the fourth level of the Body Tempering Realm, and is simply not something that Sun Bing, who has just started practicing, can resist.
Sun Bing is also struggling now. Although he really wants to kill the opponent, he cannot be exposed because he really has no way to obtain martial arts secrets after leaving the Sun family, so he can only hope to find an opportunity.
The two people looked at each other and then passed each other. It can be said that they both had their own thoughts, but their goal was surprisingly the same, that is, they wanted the other person to die.
Unconsciously, the night was already deep.
Tonight's night was particularly desolate. Even the bright moonlight in the past was blocked by dark clouds, instantly making the entire Luoyun Town pitch black. Only the courtyards of wealthy families could see light.
"The moon is dark and the wind is high, it's a murderous night." In a remote room, Sun Yong changed into dark clothes and prepared to steal the secret book of martial arts.
Sun Bing's residence is quite remote, which is also his own choice. Anyway, his presence in the family is quite low, so it is good to be far away from the crowd. Even the patrolling guards here are too lazy to come. As long as nothing big happens, the place will not attract attention at all.
So Sun Yong acted very boldly. Soon he came to the dilapidated door and cautiously peeked inside. But before he could check it clearly, a voice suddenly came from his ears: "Why don't you come in and sit down?"
This made Sun Yong feel like a frightened bird. His muscles tensed instantly and he jumped back. When the door opened, he saw Sun Bing sitting cross-legged in the room with a wooden sword lying across his legs. It seemed that he had been waiting for a long time.
"I've been discovered" was the only thought in Sun Yong's mind, but instead of running away, he showed a ruthless look on his face, because it would be more difficult to retreat and come back to steal it now. It would be better to change it to robbery and directly pull out his sword.
Looking at the flash of cold light, Sun Bing did not have any worries, but was full of excitement. The last time he killed Sun Yang, the main role was the first sword he used in his life. It contained too much energy and spirit. It was as powerful as drawing a sword and slashing. The opponent had no resistance at all. He could kill Sun Yang instantly, but in the end he did not get any combat experience.
Today, he happened to have an opponent who could sharpen himself. He was holding a black wooden sword and fighting Sun Yong in front of him.
The wooden sword made a muffled sound when it came into contact with the iron sword, but there was no sign of being cut off. This made Sun Yong's eyes flash with surprise, because in his heart, Sun Bing had only just been able to practice, and as for him, he had already reached the fourth level of body tempering.
Although the sword was blocked, Sun Yong was not worried at all, because it was just a casual blow from him. It would not be a big deal if he could catch it. However, his attitude was a little serious: "I didn't expect you to be able to catch my casual blow. Be careful next time."
After that, he directly used basic sword skills and swung his sword forward again. However, Sun Bing looked at the somewhat crude sword skills and smiled sarcastically. Each sword could hit the opponent's flaw skillfully. No matter how powerful his power was, it was of no avail.
In a short time, the two people had fought for several rounds, and the only sound of sword dancing could be heard in the small courtyard.
As time went by, a kind of fear gradually arose in Sun Yong's heart. He really didn't expect that Sun Bing would be so strong after not seeing him for just a few days. At the same time, his heart was filled with jealousy and cruelty.
If Sun Yong originally just wanted to steal the secret book to frame him, now he doesn't want to do it anymore. Instead, he prefers to kill Sun Bing tonight. Even if there is a risk of exposure, he doesn't care.
title_en: Chapter 7 The First Battle Chapter 8 The Mysterious Sword Box
